mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unclaimed_devices (mac_address, last_seen) VALUES (#{macAddress}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT mac_address, last_seen FROM unclaimed_devices ORDER BY last_seen DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_pairings (mac_address, source_id, created_at) VALUES (#{macAddress}, #{sourceId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_pairings WHERE mac_address = #{macAddress}
SELECT u.api_key AS deviceApiKey, s.str_id AS sourceStrId FROM device_pairings dp JOIN water_sources s ON dp.source_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE dp.mac_address = #{macAddress}
SELECT id FROM users WHERE api_key = #{apiKey}
